summary: Rubico Inc., a Marshall Islands water transportation company, filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with B. Riley Securities on August 5, 2026. Under the agreement, Rubico may issue and sell up to $25 million of its common shares through the agent. This is a routine equity distribution facility, not a special situation. No premium, target, or strategic event is involved. The filing incorporates the agreement and legal opinion into an existing F-3 shelf. Watch for ordinary course share issuances, but no risk-arb or special-situation angle applies.
